Setting up a live translated session

SimuTalk lets two or more people talk to each other in different languages in real time. Each participant hears the others in their own language, with a delay of usually less than two seconds.

Before you start

You need a browser that supports WebRTC, such as the current version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari. Use a headset. Laptop speakers cause echo, and echo makes the speech recognition produce wrong words. Make sure your connection allows at least 100 kilobits per second upload per participant. On a mobile network, switch off battery saving mode because it reduces microphone quality.

Creating a session

1. Sign in and open the Sessions page.
2. Click New session and give it a name, for example Weekly sync with Lyon.
3. Choose the session type. Meeting is for groups of up to twelve people. Conversation is for two people and has slightly lower latency. Presentation is for one speaker and many listeners.
4. Select the languages that will be spoken. You can add up to six languages per session. Participants choose their own language when they join, so you do not have to assign languages to people.
5. Decide whether the session should be recorded. Recordings are stored for 30 days and include the original audio, the transcript in every language and the translated audio.
6. Click Create. You get a link and a six digit code.

Inviting people

Send the link or the code to the participants. People who join with the link are taken straight to the session. People who join with the code go to the join page and enter the code. Nobody needs an account to join, but participants without an account cannot download the recording afterwards.

During the session

Speak normally and finish your sentences. The system waits for a short pause, about half a second, before it translates, so very long sentences without pauses are translated later. If you see the orange microphone icon, your audio level is too low and you should move the microphone closer. If the icon turns red, the system cannot hear you at all and you should check that the browser has permission to use the microphone.

Each participant can change their own voice at any time by clicking the speaker icon next to their name. The voice is only heard by the other participants in their language, it does not change what you hear.

The transcript panel on the right shows every sentence in your language with the speaker's name. Click a sentence to hear the original audio. Click the flag to report a wrong translation. Reports are used to improve the system and are reviewed within two working days.

Ending the session

The host ends the session by clicking End for everyone. Participants can leave at any time by closing the tab. When the session ends, the transcript and the recording, if enabled, appear on the Sessions page within five minutes. The host can share the transcript with a link, download it as a text file, or delete it. Deleted sessions cannot be restored.

Troubleshooting

If translations stop arriving for more than ten seconds, reload the page. Your place in the session is kept for two minutes. If the problem continues, check the status page at status.simutalk.example and contact support with the session code.
